verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: verify Xenoverse 2 identity, cast exclusivity, costs, mechanics, and acquisition status. Preserve N/A unlocks and unsupported fields explicitly.
research_scope: Dragon Thunder — Strike Super / cast-exclusive research.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled repository research with current Xenoverse 2-specific technique/character documentation and independent Dragon Ball technique documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No duplicate research batch for Dragon Thunder was found; canonical identity remains Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Dragon Thunder returns in Xenoverse 2 as Omega Shenron's Super Skill and is treated by the repository as a Strike Super / counter-related skill.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The reviewed sources consistently identify Omega Shenron and Omega Shenron (Supervillain) as users and state that the Future Warrior cannot obtain Dragon Thunder because of the technique's cast-specific execution.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because there is no Future Warrior acquisition route.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Repository research records 100 Ki; stamina cost remains null.
verification_audit.conflict_note: One secondary source describes a backward electric shock that cannot be blocked, while the repository's Xenoverse 2-specific research describes the in-game spike-impalement anti-air version. The repository preserves the Xenoverse 2-specific characterization rather than importing mechanics from other games.

records.name: Dragon Thunder
records.skill_description: Omega Shenron extends the spikes on his back to impale an opponent above him, producing a short-range multi-hit Strike attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Xenoverse 2-specific research describes Dragon Thunder as a short-range anti-air Strike Super that extends Omega Shenron's back spikes to impale an opponent above him, producing a multi-hit launch. Independent character documentation confirms Dragon Thunder is in both base and Supervillain Omega Shenron's Xenoverse 2 movesets. A conflicting secondary description appears to mix in a different game's implementation; it is not imported into the canonical Xenoverse 2 mechanics.
records.acquisition_notes: Dragon Thunder remains cast-exclusive to Omega Shenron / Omega Shenron (Supervillain) and unavailable to the Future Warrior. The reviewed sources provide no CaC acquisition route, so unlock_method remains Unavailable for CaC and source_quest_or_shop remains N/A.
records.pve_notes: Cast-exclusive; no CaC acquisition route or Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.pvp_notes: Anti-air, short-range, launching behavior is documented; exact frame and matchup values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
